schema_scope: Runtime-derived structural JSON Schemas plus the listed permission, Unicode-scalar, source binding, timestamp validity, receipt-ID equality and policy invariants. JSON Schema alone does not grant permission or prove these cross-field invariants.

function.name: memory_save
function.description: Save the current human's literal remember request. No paraphrases or other authors. Confirm only the returned receipt.

function.name: memory_forget
function.description: Forget an exact authorized ID from a direct forget request. Omit id to list candidates for clarification; ambiguous requests delete nothing.

capabilities: all six valid observation limits and three management limits
caller: raw non-bot, non-webhook human in approved Discord scope
direct current remember request with literal content
memory_save.arguments: Empty object only. Model cannot supply actor, bank, source, text, time, provenance or subjects.

capabilities: features.memory_management=true with all three valid limits
caller: personal only in the requesting human's DM
bank derived from signed Discord event and included in caller read banks
raw current request selects exact namespace and ID: forget evidence #ID or forget fact #ID; optional in/from my/this/the personal/channel/server
other requests return clarification candidates and delete nothing
backend: evidence requires full-bank read and forget authority

semantics.evidence: Saves entire literal current request as human_input. Source author remains distinct from semantic subjects; subjects=null means unresolved. No assistant paraphrase, atomisation or surprise admission.
semantics.idempotence: Independent explicit source-revision receipt and fingerprinted request ID survive retries. Forgotten saves return status=forgotten and active_ids=[]; replay cannot restore plaintext. Caller freezes forget revision in a durable digest-only journal.
semantics.outcomes: Memory controls execute alone. runToolTurn returns terminal_turn with memoryToolResult. The responder presents its deterministic content and performs no further model call. No native role=tool or tagged continuation message is emitted for these terminal controls.
semantics.failure: dispatchToolCall throws on failed authorization, validation or HTTP. runToolTurn converts that failure to completed=false and an unconfirmed terminal message. completed=true with clarification_required is a completed read, not proof of a save or deletion.
semantics.transport: dispatcher is the actual dispatchToolCall return. tool_result is memoryToolResult within the terminal turn, not a serialized model tool message.
semantics.scope: No clear, source-wide erasure, arbitrary actor or arbitrary bank model argument exists. Existing slash and search behavior is retained.
